measuredFidelity.result: all nine metrics inside tolerance of the concept — unchanged by the runtime render fixes, which is the point: measure:fidelity grades the Blender board, not the runtime.
measuredFidelity.note: The rig's 6.75-degree leg splay (render.leg-stance) settled ankle daylight at 48.5% against the concept's 46.9%. Round 7 then found that Junebug's SIGNATURE idle pose carried an 8-degree inward leg roll, authored when the rig ran its legs straight down, which closed the ankles to 0.325ft against the bind pose's 0.756 and failed rubric 3.12 in idle while the bind-pose render this command reads stayed correct. The same roll was in all five signature idles and was removed from all of them; an FK sweep now reads every idle within 2% of bind. Re-measured 2026-08-12 after the detector itself was rebuilt to work for the whole roster: the backdrop is now sampled per column (seven sheets are vignetted past the old tolerance), a column counts as occupied by fraction rather than by any single pixel, and the shoe's two tones are read off the concept instead of the hardcoded red/cream that was Junebug's own shoe. Her shoe deltas TIGHTENED, from +2.23/+2.93 under the old classifier to +0.43/-0.78 as tone shares (41.2/25.5 concept against 41.6/24.8 delivered); the round-7 critic note below quotes the old red/cream figures and is left as the record of what was measured then.

frontProfileSilhouette.label: front/profile silhouette
frontProfileSilhouette.note: Critic (round 7, independent): large read matches by measurement — head 34.0% of figure height vs the turnaround's 34.0%, head aspect 0.82 vs 0.84, profile waist depth 13.77% vs 13.69% and hip 14.11% vs 13.81%. Held off 5 by three butt-joined terminations, all in junebug-profile-review.png: the ponytail tip is a faceted wedge butt-joined to the tail with a notch either side (x 370-400, y 245-290), the headband ends in a flat-cut stub inside the hair mass 37px above the ear top (band last appears y 150, x 302..324) where the concept sweeps it behind the ear to the jaw, and the bun cap meets the crown ring on a hard shelf (front view y 78-88, x 235-305).

headBodyProportions.label: head/body proportions
headBodyProportions.note: Critic (round 7, independent): child proportion is exact — head height delta -0.01, head width/figure height 0.279 vs the concept's 0.285, face-skin component aspect 1.266 vs 1.256. Held off 5 by the pelvis-to-thigh transition, which reads as a slab set on two cylinders: a straight horizontal edge across both thigh tops at junebug-front-review.png y 437 with a lateral overhang notch at x 215 and x 325. One interpolated ring between the pelvis bottom and the thigh top would close it.

hairMass.label: hair mass
hairMass.note: Critic (round 7, independent): one designed mass, hairline reads front and side, no bare skull in any of the gameplay renders, and the round-4 lopsided-temple blocker is measurably gone (0.00 face asymmetry from the shipped detector). Capped at 4 by the rubric's own words — a smooth featureless blob caps at 4 however correct its silhouette. Quantified: contrast-stretched at 6x the concept's bun carries 4-10 strand minima per row at 3.8-4.6 counts of prominence, the delivered 1-4 at 1.8-4.1, and what is there is polygon faceting rather than periodic grooves. The authored 8-lobe 0.015ft groove is at its clearance ceiling, so the contrast has to come from a sharper crease profile or more columns, not more depth.

clothingConstruction.label: clothing construction
clothingConstruction.note: Critic (round 7, independent): genuinely constructed — V-neck trim, sleeve cuffs and shoulder stripes, three-button placket, belt with loops, pant hem cuffs, socks, and a shoe that is now ONE lasted upper with a painted toe cap, collar band and midsole plus three swept lace straps. Shoe colour split measured 39.5% red / 49.2% cream against the concept's 37.3 / 46.2, both inside tolerance, and shoe length is not a defect (0.62ft delivered against ~0.67ft for the concept's near shoe). Held off 5 by shoe detailing: the three laces still read as detached pegs standing proud of the vamp rather than straps lying on it, the midsole vanishes under the toe cap so there is no sole line at the front, and there is no heel counter panel or ankle collar (junebug-profile-review.png x 245-275, y 605-625).

faceExpressionRead.label: face/expression read
faceExpressionRead.note: Critic (round 7, independent): both round-6 blockers retired and measured. The left/right face shading split is 6.4 / 6.3 / 8.1 / 5.4 counts (forehead/eye/cheek/jaw) against the concept's 6.7 / 2.8 / 4.9 / 2.5, where round 6 measured 30.8 and 39.9 — the cause was two things, an unmirrored face column in head_surface (the head skin now mirrors to 0.0000 milli-ft, verified from the shipped GLB) and the board's own fill light, which keyed from +x and filled from BEHIND on -x. Nose relief re-measures +26.2 counts against the concept's +20.5, and on the profile silhouette the tip stands 0.064ft off the local face plane against an authored target of 0.067 and the concept's own 0.048-0.053 — round 6's '+6.5 vs +14.7' was measured through the lopsided light and does not survive. All three of the rubric's named 5/5 clauses are met (real nose breaks the profile, no decal-island seam under a Sobel map, features integrated with the skull); the 5 is withheld for cheek tessellation at hero, which is not a named clause.

heroAndFieldScale.label: hero + 40px read
heroAndFieldScale.note: Critic (round 7, independent): identity survives both ends — at hero the brows, headband, bun and ponytail all read, and at 40px the light headband over a dark bun on a red top survives the pixel zoom. Both round-4 reasons for a 3 here are measurably gone: the feet no longer fuse (ankle daylight 48.5% against the concept's 46.9%, from 3%) and the face is no longer a dark-framed mask (36.4% visible face per side against 31.1/31.9).

priorHumanReview.verdict: approved — reviewed the shipped model in production at https://srgirsky.github.io/recess-sports/ after rounds 5-7 rebuilt the shoe as one lasted upper, reshaped the ear, deepened the run's arm swing, mirrored the face columns and restored the splayed stance in every signature idle. The six category scores recorded here are the round-7 independent critic's, not the sculptor's.

demotion.reason: The runtime face-atlas composite was fixed (it ran a shader chunk before the identity palette, so white x skin = skin and no character had eye whites) and the tone mapping moved from ACES to Neutral 1.25. Both re-render the runtime hero, which the fidelity board composites, so the board this approval was bound to no longer exists. Nothing about the sculpt changed and the GLB is byte-identical. This is a re-approval on better evidence, not a regression.
